# -Q load-path flags for coqc invocations against the dune-built theories in this project,
# relative to this file's own directory (datalog-rocq/). Hand-written rather than generated by
# dune's own (generate_project_file) (its output/target name proved unreliable to depend on and
# is meant for editor/Merlin integration, not this) -- these paths are the stable
# _build/default/<source path> mirror dune produces for each (rocq.theory (name ...)) stanza (see
# dune-project/dune/src/dune, and datalog/dune + datalog/src/{util,datalog}/dune upstream), so they
# only need updating if a theory's source directory or name actually changes.
#
# Regenerate/verify by comparing against: find _build/default -name "*.vo" | sed -E 's#/[^/]+\.vo$##' | sort -u
-Q _build/default/datalog/src/util Datalog.Util
-Q _build/default/datalog/src/datalog Datalog
-Q _build/default/datalog/graph_search/coqutil/src/coqutil coqutil
-Q _build/default/datalog/graph_search/src GraphSearch
-Q _build/default/src DatalogRocq
